dev.ketsuyumi.ao3-reader.name: AO3 Reader
dev.ketsuyumi.ao3-reader.description: Read AO3 works inside Discord, made for phones: AO3 links open in a clean reader with text size, spacing, serif/sans and themes (sepia, dark, AMOLED black), a chapter list, and your place saved in a library.
dev.ketsuyumi.ao3-reader.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.auto-collapse.name: Auto Collapse
dev.ketsuyumi.auto-collapse.description: Collapses the categories with nothing new when you open a server, new or old, and opens the ones with new messages.
dev.ketsuyumi.auto-collapse.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.better-dms.name: Better DMs
dev.ketsuyumi.better-dms.description: Make DMs easier to tell apart: colours, labels, emoji, pins, tabs (with a Groups tab), unread, last-active and mutual-server hints, a name banner, a send check for careful chats, private nicknames and more. Every part can be turned off.
dev.ketsuyumi.better-dms.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.block-by-id.name: Block by ID
dev.ketsuyumi.block-by-id.description: Block any Discord user by pasting their user ID, even if you share no server or DM with them.
dev.ketsuyumi.block-by-id.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.bulk-mute.name: Bulk Mute
dev.ketsuyumi.bulk-mute.description: A bell next to a server's search bar: tap channels to select them, like selecting messages on WhatsApp, then mute them all forever at once (or unmute).
dev.ketsuyumi.bulk-mute.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.compact-status.name: Compact Status
dev.ketsuyumi.compact-status.description: A smaller Change Online Status sheet: your avatar and the four statuses as one row of big icons (tap one), with the custom status under them.
dev.ketsuyumi.compact-status.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.default-typing.name: Default Typing Indicator
dev.ketsuyumi.default-typing.description: Shows everyone's typing indicator as Discord's plain dots, without custom animated emoji wiggling around.
dev.ketsuyumi.default-typing.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.dm-details-plus.name: DM Details+
dev.ketsuyumi.dm-details-plus.description: On a DM's details screen: hide the New Group button and the Files tab, and add Stickers and Emoji tabs.
dev.ketsuyumi.dm-details-plus.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.download-emojis.name: Download Emojis & Stickers
dev.ketsuyumi.download-emojis.description: Long-press a server: Download Emojis or Download Stickers saves all of them to your phone as one zip.
dev.ketsuyumi.download-emojis.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.embed-playback.name: Embed Playback
dev.ketsuyumi.embed-playback.description: Play YouTube videos from chat in a player right over the chat instead of leaving Discord, and shrink it to a floating picture-in-picture window that keeps playing while you scroll and switch channels.
dev.ketsuyumi.embed-playback.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.floating-browser.name: Floating Browser
dev.ketsuyumi.floating-browser.description: A browser window that floats over Discord, so videos keep playing while you chat: drag, resize, presets, bookmarks, and extensions (pop-up blocker, ad hider, dark pages, video focus, desktop site, your own user scripts).
dev.ketsuyumi.floating-browser.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")
contributors: dxckie (finding the web view, Spotify Preview, GPL-3.0)

dev.ketsuyumi.forum-grid.name: Forum Grid
dev.ketsuyumi.forum-grid.description: See forum posts as a grid of cards with images, and filter them by tags, unread, followed, images, your posts, date and reactions, with more ways to sort.
dev.ketsuyumi.forum-grid.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.friends-export.name: Friends Export
dev.ketsuyumi.friends-export.description: Export your friends list (and optionally blocked users and requests) as text, CSV or JSON: copy it, save it to a file, or use /friendslist.
dev.ketsuyumi.friends-export.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.hide-dms.name: Hide DMs
dev.ketsuyumi.hide-dms.description: Hide chosen DMs and group DMs, or all of them, from your DM list without leaving them.
dev.ketsuyumi.hide-dms.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.hide-server-banners.name: Hide Server Banners
dev.ketsuyumi.hide-server-banners.description: Hides server banners at the top of the channel list, so every server uses the compact header.
dev.ketsuyumi.hide-server-banners.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.hide-stream-previews.name: Hide Stream Previews
dev.ketsuyumi.hide-stream-previews.description: Hides the floating call / stream preview tile that stays over the chat after you leave the call screen. Switch it on or off from the call's own menu.
dev.ketsuyumi.hide-stream-previews.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")
contributors: il1ll (adding a row to the call menu, Mute Bubble, GPL-3.0)

dev.ketsuyumi.ignore-apps.name: Ignore Apps
dev.ketsuyumi.ignore-apps.description: Hide messages from apps and bots that Discord doesn't let you block or ignore, like MEE6.
dev.ketsuyumi.ignore-apps.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.meow-picker.name: Meow Picker
dev.ketsuyumi.meow-picker.description: A cat button by the emoji button in chat. It opens a picker like the emoji one, full of meows, mrrps, purrs, hisses, cat actions and cat kaomoji. Tap one to add it to your message, long-press to send it.
dev.ketsuyumi.meow-picker.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.no-blackout.name: No Blackout
dev.ketsuyumi.no-blackout.description: Stops the screen going black during calls when the proximity sensor is covered (for example by a finger near the top of the screen). Android only.
dev.ketsuyumi.no-blackout.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.profile-widgets.name: Profile Widgets
dev.ketsuyumi.profile-widgets.description: Edit your profile's game widgets on mobile: add, remove and reorder games in Favorite Game, Games in Rotation, Games I Like and Want to Play, with comments and tags.
dev.ketsuyumi.profile-widgets.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.quick-folders.name: Quick Folders
dev.ketsuyumi.quick-folders.description: Long-press a server and choose Move to folder: pick a folder, make a new one, or take it out of its folder. No dragging.
dev.ketsuyumi.quick-folders.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.quick-reload.name: Quick Access
dev.ketsuyumi.quick-reload.description: Shortcut buttons next to the bell on the bar with your name: reload Discord, open Friends, Plugins or Performance Monitor. Each has its own switch. Also a "Reload Discord" row in Discord's settings. Formerly Quick Reload.
dev.ketsuyumi.quick-reload.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.shop-browser.name: Shop Browser
dev.ketsuyumi.shop-browser.description: The Discord Shop like on desktop: a Featured | Browse switch in the Shop with Browse sections, Sort by, and a filter panel (item type, Orbs eligible, collabs, owned, colour, theme). Nameplates show as long bars, effects and frames big.
dev.ketsuyumi.shop-browser.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.smaller-media.name: Smaller Media
dev.ketsuyumi.smaller-media.description: Makes images, GIFs and videos in chat 30 to 50% smaller, from you and everyone else. Only the preview shrinks: tapping still opens them full size and videos and GIFs still play.
dev.ketsuyumi.smaller-media.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.spectators.name: Spectators
dev.ketsuyumi.spectators.description: See who is watching a stream, yours or someone else's, like on PC. Optional notices when people start or stop watching, and a notification with the count while you stream, also outside the app.
dev.ketsuyumi.spectators.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.stream-tools.name: Stream Tools
dev.ketsuyumi.stream-tools.description: More control when watching streams in a call: auto-watch and auto-focus streams (full video without tapping, great with Only Show Videos), a bar on the stream to switch streams and change its volume, and a clean view that hides other tiles and the call controls. Switches in the call's menu.
dev.ketsuyumi.stream-tools.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")
contributors: il1ll (stream actions, Stream Button; adding a row to the call menu, Mute Bubble, GPL-3.0)

dev.ketsuyumi.theme.ame.name: Ame-chan
dev.ketsuyumi.theme.ame.description: A cute, readable NEEDY STREAMER OVERLOAD theme inspired by Ame-chan: soft plum surfaces, cherry-red accents and gold links. Comes with an optional background.
dev.ketsuyumi.theme.ame.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.theme.aubrey.name: Aubrey
dev.ketsuyumi.theme.aubrey.description: A cute, readable OMORI theme inspired by Aubrey: soft plum surfaces, bow-pink accents and mint links. Comes with an optional background.
dev.ketsuyumi.theme.aubrey.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.theme.mari.name: Mari
dev.ketsuyumi.theme.mari.description: A cute, readable OMORI theme inspired by Mari: violet-night surfaces, her blue vest for accents and coral links. Comes with an optional background.
dev.ketsuyumi.theme.mari.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")

dev.ketsuyumi.watch-together-adblock.name: Watch Together Ad Block
dev.ketsuyumi.watch-together-adblock.description: No YouTube ads in Discord's Watch Together activity: ad data is taken out before the player sees it, ad overlays are hidden, and any ad that still starts is skipped.
dev.ketsuyumi.watch-together-adblock.author: Satou (https://github.com/inkmachinegirl "GitHub")
